Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly analyze the search results for "Marco Da Silva date of birth." The visible text in the browser clearly shows multiple distinct individuals: Marco Silva (born July 12, 1977), Marco da Silva Ignácio (born June 15, 1989), and Marco da Silva (born April 10, 1992). Additionally, an auto-generated snippet claims "Marco Da Silva was born on May 30, 1977," which is factually incorrect based on the provided Wikipedia entry for Marco Alexandre Saraiva da Silva (born July 12, 1977). Despite these clear discrepancies and the existence of multiple candidates, the agent incorrectly summarized the finding as a single date ("noted his date of birth as 1965" in the first instance, then "May 30, 1977" in the second) without acknowledging the ambiguity or listing the other prominent candidates found in the viewport. This failure to disambiguate prevented the Planner from making a correct decision.
